A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
using NGS data to estimate relationships between cultivars of the same species is feasible, but the number of genes used to construct the tree must be carefully selected.
NGS can be used to construct species trees using allelic information, however the benefit of doing this depends on the genetic divergence of the genotypes under study.

the use of allelic data for species tree estimation may be useful in cases where the number of orthologous loci is limited, but it is not an absolute necessity for the resolution of phylogenetic relationships.
